time.zh: 清晨第一束低角度自然光
time.en: the first low-angle natural light of early morning

time.zh: 下午偏暖的侧向自然光
time.en: warm side light in the afternoon

time.zh: 日落前最后一段低角度暖光
time.en: the last low warm light before sunset

time.zh: 阴天均匀柔和的漫射光
time.en: soft even diffuse light under an overcast sky

weather.en: leaves still carrying droplets after rain
a faint mist lingering in the distance

weather.zh: 微风刚刚经过，少量叶片仍在偏转
weather.en: a light breeze has just passed and a few leaves are still turned

weather.zh: 空气略带潮湿感但能见度很高
weather.en: slightly humid air with high visibility

camera_micro.zh: 镜头比植物根部略低，向上寻找出口
camera_micro.en: camera slightly below the plant base, looking upward for an exit

camera_micro.zh: 镜头被前景叶片压低，只留下狭窄视线
camera_micro.en: foreground leaves press close to the lens, leaving a narrow sightline

camera_micro.zh: 镜头向一侧轻微偏移，让通道形成非对称斜向透视
camera_micro.en: camera shifted slightly to one side, creating an asymmetric diagonal corridor

camera_micro.zh: 镜头极贴近地表，前景尺度被夸张放大
camera_micro.en: camera almost touching the ground, exaggerating foreground scale

camera_micro.zh: 镜头沿自然缝隙向前探入，形成更强的穿行感
camera_micro.en: camera probing forward through a natural gap for a stronger sense of passage

window_shape.en: the window is narrow and irregular

window_shape.zh: 窗口偏离画面中心约三分之一
window_shape.en: the window sits about one third off center

window_shape.zh: 窗口被几片近景叶片部分遮住
window_shape.en: the window is partially occluded by a few near leaves

window_shape.zh: 窗口更小，只占画面很少面积
window_shape.en: the window is smaller and occupies very little of the frame

window_shape.zh: 窗口略微扩大，但仍保持克制
window_shape.en: the window is slightly wider but still restrained

moment.zh: 一片叶子刚刚转动并捕捉到光
moment.en: one leaf has just turned and caught the light

moment.zh: 一滴水珠正从叶尖落下
moment.en: a droplet is just falling from a leaf tip

moment.zh: 一朵小花刚被风压向通道方向
moment.en: a small flower has just been bent toward the corridor by the breeze

moment.zh: 远处亮部第一次穿透植物间隙
moment.en: distant light has just broken through the vegetation gap

moment.zh: 前景一片叶子刚离开镜头中心，露出后方窗口
moment.en: a foreground leaf has just moved away from the lens center, revealing the window

seasonal_trace.zh: 植物处于刚刚萌发的早期状态
seasonal_trace.en: vegetation is in an early emerging state

seasonal_trace.zh: 植物处于最茂盛的生长期
少量叶缘已经出现季节转换痕迹
seasonal_trace.en: a few leaf edges show signs of seasonal transition

seasonal_trace.zh: 环境保留上一场雨或露水留下的痕迹
seasonal_trace.en: the environment retains traces of recent rain or dew

seasonal_trace.zh: 少量枯叶与新叶同时存在
seasonal_trace.en: a few old leaves coexist with fresh growth

foreground_occlusion.zh: 一片巨大近景叶片从左上角压入
foreground_occlusion.en: one huge near leaf enters from the upper left

foreground_occlusion.zh: 两根近景茎秆交错经过镜头边缘
foreground_occlusion.en: two near stems cross along the lens edge

foreground_occlusion.zh: 前景只保留一处柔和失焦遮挡
foreground_occlusion.en: keep only one softly defocused foreground occlusion

foreground_occlusion.zh: 下方近景植物占据更多面积，强化钻入感
foreground_occlusion.en: lower foreground vegetation occupies more space to strengthen immersion

foreground_occlusion.zh: 右侧近景叶缘擦过画面但不遮住窗口
foreground_occlusion.en: a near leaf edge brushes the right frame without covering the window

depth_rhythm.zh: 前景极近，中景拉长，远处窗口很小
depth_rhythm.en: extremely close foreground, elongated midground, very small distant window

depth_rhythm.zh: 前景克制，中景植物层次最丰富
depth_rhythm.en: restrained foreground with the richest layering in the midground

depth_rhythm.zh: 通过植物尺寸连续递减强化纵深
depth_rhythm.en: strengthen depth through continuous reduction in plant scale

depth_rhythm.zh: 利用三次自然遮挡形成层层推进
depth_rhythm.en: use three natural occlusion stages to create progressive depth

depth_rhythm.zh: 通道先窄后略微打开，再收束到窗口
depth_rhythm.en: the corridor narrows, opens slightly, then converges toward the window

hook_state.zh: 视觉钩子保持静止，周围植物有轻微运动痕迹
hook_state.en: the visual hook stays still while surrounding plants show slight motion

hook_state.zh: 视觉钩子只被一小块自然光命中
hook_state.en: only a small patch of natural light hits the visual hook

hook_state.zh: 视觉钩子部分被叶片遮挡，避免刻意展示
hook_state.en: the visual hook is partly hidden by leaves to avoid staged presentation

hook_state.zh: 视觉钩子位于窗口附近但不与窗口重叠
hook_state.en: the visual hook sits near but does not overlap the window

hook_state.zh: 视觉钩子位于中景，远景只保留出口
hook_state.en: the visual hook stays in the midground while the far layer contains only the exit

upward_sky.zh: 视线从小昆虫般的贴地高度沿植物缝隙垂直向上，只窥见一小片治愈的清澈蓝天；不出现昆虫本体，以巨大叶片和狭窄出口形成管中窥豹的发现感，寓意从低处出发、在遮挡中坚持寻找光亮并持续向上生长
upward_sky.en: from a tiny insect-scale ground-level viewpoint, look vertically upward through a narrow plant gap and glimpse a small piece of healing clear blue sky; show no insect body, using oversized leaves and a narrow exit for a peeking-through-a-tube discovery, symbolizing starting low, persisting through obstacles and continuing to grow toward light

upward_sky.zh: 镜头贴近根部并垂直向上，沿茎叶组成的天然管道窥见一线粉金朝霞；不出现昆虫本体，微小视角与高处天光形成强烈尺度反差，寓意在黑暗和阻力中迎向新一天
upward_sky.en: keep the camera close to the roots and aim vertically upward through a natural stem-and-leaf tube to glimpse a line of pink-gold dawn; show no insect body, using tiny scale against high sky light to symbolize meeting a new day through darkness and resistance

upward_sky.zh: 从低处向上穿过密集植物的狭缝，窥见一小块橙红晚霞；不出现昆虫本体，让前景遮挡像人生阻力，唯一的暖色天空成为坚持向上的光
upward_sky.en: look upward from low inside a dense plant slit and glimpse a small patch of orange-red sunset; show no insect body, letting foreground occlusion stand for life's resistance while the single warm sky opening becomes the light of upward perseverance

upward_sky.zh: 以贴地的小昆虫尺度从湿润叶片下方垂直向上，穿过水珠和枝叶窥见雨后明亮蓝天；不出现昆虫本体，形成先窄后开的管中窥豹路径，寓意经历阻力后仍向上寻找清明
upward_sky.en: from a tiny insect-scale viewpoint beneath wet leaves, look vertically upward through droplets and branches toward bright blue post-rain sky; show no insect body, creating a narrow-then-opening peeking path that symbolizes seeking clarity upward after resistance
